name: cdm/observable/asset/calculatedrate/FallbackRateParameters
description: Defines the structure needed to represent fallback rate parameters. This type is used to represent modular computed rates in interestRatePayouts.

calculationParameters.description: Support for modular calculated rates, such such as lockout compound calculations.

effectiveDate.description: The date the fallback rate takes effect.

floatingRateIndex.description: The floating rate index that is used as the basis of the fallback rate.

spreadAdjustment.description: The economic spread applied to the underlying fallback rate to replicate the original risky rate.
